## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Reproduction Steps
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Select Fort Mode: `[e.g., Raigad Blueprint / Freeform Scratch]`
2. Active Tool: `[e.g., Soil Pour / Water Sprinkler / Side Push / Spline Wall / Paint]`
3. Action performed: `[e.g., Dragged water tool across steep slope]`
4. Trigger event: `[e.g., Clicked 'Let Mud Set' or 'Generate Poster']`

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened (including any WebGL errors or console traces).

## Screenshots / Video / WebGL Traces
If applicable, attach screenshots or console error traces to help explain your problem.

## System & Client Context
- **OS:** [e.g., Windows 11, macOS Sequoia, Ubuntu 24.04, Android 14, iOS 18]
- **Browser & Version:** [e.g., Chrome 129, Firefox 131, Safari 18]
- **GPU / Renderer:** [e.g., Apple M3, NVIDIA RTX 4070, Intel Iris Xe, Adreno 740]
- **WebGL2 Support:** [Yes / No]
- **Resolution / Scale:** [e.g., 1920x1080 @ 1.0x, 2560x1440 @ 1.5x, Mobile Viewport]

## Severity & Blast Radius
- [ ] Critical (Crashes WebGL context / data loss / cannot save killa)
- [ ] High (Feature broken with no workaround)
- [ ] Medium (Visual glitch, performance drop under 30 FPS)
- [ ] Low (Cosmetic flaw or typo)
